<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>North Pasture — Four Species, Four Legs Apiece</title>
<style>
:root{
 --serif:"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
 --sans:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
 --ink:#fbf6e9; --gold:#f3ce7e; --leaf:#95d288;
 --ease:cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.5,1);
 --spd:1;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0b1d14}
body{font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#scene{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;display:block}
text{font-family:var(--sans)}

/* ---- living pieces ---- */
.bounce{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:hop var(--dur) var(--del) infinite}
.animal.pop .bounce{animation:hopPop .62s cubic-bezier(.28,1.5,.5,1) 1}
.hs{transform:scale(1);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.animal{cursor:pointer}
.animal:hover .hs,.animal:focus .hs,.animal.hot .hs{transform:scale(1.055)}
.shadow{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:shpulse var(--dur) var(--del) infinite;pointer-events:none}
.rays{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:spin 96s linear infinite}
.pulse{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:ring 5s ease-out infinite}
.eyes{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:blink var(--bd,5.6s) var(--bdl,0s) infinite}
.blade{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:sway var(--sd,3.6s) ease-in-out var(--sdelay,0s) infinite alternate}
.wings{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:flutter .17s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.birdwing{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:flap var(--fd,.5s) ease-in-out infinite}
.beam{animation:beams 17s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.tag{opacity:0;transform:translateY(7px);transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .45s var(--ease);pointer-events:none}
.animal:hover .tag,.animal:focus .tag,.animal.hot .tag{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.tn{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px;fill:#fffef8;letter-spacing:.01em}
.ts{font-size:8.5px;fill:#cbe4bc;letter-spacing:.19em;font-weight:600}

@keyframes hop{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(1)}12%{transform:translateY(2px) scaleY(.976)}
 34%{transform:translateY(-14px) scaleY(1.032)}58%{transform:translateY(1px) scaleY(.994)}72%{transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes hopPop{0%{transform:translateY(0)}18%{transform:translateY(4px) scaleY(.96)}
 45%{transform:translateY(-34px) scaleY(1.06)}78%{transform:translateY(2px)}100%{transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes shpulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.62}12%{transform:scale(1.06);opacity:.72}34%{transform:scale(.84);opacity:.36}58%{transform:scale(1.02);opacity:.58}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes ring{0%{transform:scale(.82);opacity:.5}70%{opacity:0}100%{transform:scale(1.62);opacity:0}}
@keyframes blink{0%,89%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}92%{transform:scaleY(.08)}95%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@keyframes sway{from{transform:rotate(-3.2deg)}to{transform:rotate(3.6deg)}}
@keyframes flutter{from{transform:scaleX(1)}to{transform:scaleX(.34)}}
@keyframes flap{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}50%{transform:scaleY(.28)}}
@keyframes beams{from{opacity:.10}to{opacity:.24}}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* ---- interface ---- */
.ui{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
 padding:clamp(14px,2.4vw,32px);pointer-events:none;z-index:5}
.brand{max-width:min(54ch,64vw);animation:rise .9s var(--ease) both}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;
 text-transform:uppercase;color:#eaf6d9;text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(8,40,18,.7);margin:0 0 6px}
.pip{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(243,206,126,.22)}
.clock{margin-left:auto;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.14em}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.7rem,8.6vw,6.4rem);line-height:.84;
 margin:0;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-shadow:0 6px 30px rgba(7,38,17,.55)}
h1 .it{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
h1 .sm{display:block;font-size:.26em;letter-spacing:.42em;text-transform:uppercase;
 font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);margin-top:.9em}
.dek{font-size:clamp(.8rem,1.2vw,.95rem);line-height:1.55;max-width:40ch;margin:14px 0 0;
 color:rgba(246,255,240,.86);text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(8,40,18,.7)}
.deck{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:clamp(8px,1.2vw,16px);align-items:flex-end;pointer-events:none}
.panel{pointer-events:auto;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,48,31,.92),rgba(9,28,17,.94));
 border:1px solid rgba(214,244,196,.22);border-radius:4px 4px 14px 14px;padding:14px 16px 13px;
 box-shadow:0 22px 46px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.72),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14);
 animation:rise .9s var(--ease) both;animation-delay:.18s;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.ptitle{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a9d69b;margin:0 0 10px;
 display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-weight:700}
.lg{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px 6px 10px;border-left:2px solid rgba(149,210,136,.28);
 cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s,border-color .25s,transform .3s var(--ease);border-radius:0 6px 6px 0}
.lg:hover,.lg.on{background:rgba(149,210,136,.14);border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateX(3px)}
.lg b{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:1.22rem;letter-spacing:.01em}
.lg i{font-style:normal;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a9d69b;flex:1}
.lg em{font-style:normal;font-size:1.12rem;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--gold);
 min-width:2.4ch;text-align:right}
.ctrl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;
 border-top:1px dashed rgba(214,244,196,.28)}
.ctrl label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.22em;
 text-transform:uppercase;color:#bcdcb0}
input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:78px;height:2px;background:rgba(214,244,196,.34);
 border-radius:2px;outline:none;cursor:pointer}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;
 background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(243,206,126,.24);transition:transform .2s}
input[type=range]:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb{transform:scale(1.28)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:13px;height:13px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.btn{margin-left:auto;font:inherit;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);
 background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(214,244,196,.4);padding:7px 13px;border-radius:99px;cursor:pointer;
 transition:background .25s,transform .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#16331f;border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn[aria-pressed=true]{background:rgba(243,206,126,.2);border-color:var(--gold)}
@media (max-width:640px){.dek{display:none}h1{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,13vw,3.2rem)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg id="scene" viewBox="0 0 1600 900" role="img" aria-label="Animated pasture with a cow, sheep, pig and horse">
<defs>
 <linearGradient id="gSky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
  <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4da9e4"/><stop offset=".42" stop-color="#92d4f1"/>
  <stop offset=".78" stop-color="#c9ecf8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#effaf5"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="gGrass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
  <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6db84f"/><stop offset=".18" stop-color="#4f9e43"/>

 <linearGradient id="gCloud" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="-48" x2="0" y2="30">
  <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset=".62" stop-color="#f8fcff"/>
  <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d5e8f8"/></linearGradient>

  <stop offset=".52" stop-color="#ffe873" stop-opacity=".38"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffe873" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>

  <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffce0"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#ffe766"/>
  <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fbc63f"/></radialGradient>

 </g></g>
</g>

<g id="animalLayer">

  </g></g>
  <ellipse class="shadow" fill="url(#gShadow)"/>
  <g class="tag"><rect x="-74" y="-34" width="148" height="32" rx="8" fill="#12301c" opacity=".88"/>
   <text class="tn" x="-60" y="-12">Horse</text><text class="ts" x="36" y="-13">01</text></g>

 </g>

 <!-- ============ COW ============ -->

   <ellipse cx="68" cy="-92" rx="60" ry="38" fill="none" stroke="#ddd4bd" stroke-width="1.4"/>
   <ellipse cx="86" cy="-58" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#f0a2b6"/>
   <rect x="80" y="-51" width="5" height="9" rx="2.5" fill="#e28ba4"/><rect x="89" y="-51" width="5" height="9" rx="2.5" fill="#e28ba4"/>
   <path d="M104,-126 L122,-138 L138,-110 L118,-96 Z" fill="#f4f0e4"/>
   <g class="head">
    <path d="M122,-142 C116,-150 116,-158 122,-161" stroke="#f0e2b8" stroke-width="5.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M154,-142 C160,-150 160,-158 154,-161" stroke="#f0e2b8" stroke-width="5.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="112" cy="-134" rx="12" ry="6.5" transform="rotate(-22 112 -134)" fill="#f2ecdc"/>

    <ellipse cx="113" cy="-133" rx="6" ry="3" transform="rotate(-22 113 -133)" fill="#edb3c1"/>

    <ellipse cx="138" cy="-124" rx="25" ry="23" fill="#fbf8ef"/>
    <g clip-path="url(#cCowHead)"><ellipse cx="126" cy="-140" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#2b2b33"/>
     <ellipse cx="138" cy="-146" rx="20" ry="7" fill="#fff" opacity=".5"/></g>
    <ellipse cx="138" cy="-124" rx="25" ry="23" fill="none" stroke="#ddd4bd" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <g class="eyes"><circle cx="129" cy="-125" r="4.3" fill="#26262e"/><circle cx="148" cy="-125" r="4.3" fill="#26262e"/>
     <circle cx="127.6" cy="-126.6" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="146.6" cy="-126.6" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/></g>
    <ellipse cx="138" cy="-107" rx="17" ry="12" fill="#f0a2b6"/>
    <ellipse cx="132" cy="-108" rx="2.6" ry="2.1" fill="#c4738b"/><ellipse cx="144" cy="-108" rx="2.6" ry="2.1" fill="#c4738b"/>
